attributes.description: This dashboard shows Breaches collected by the Flashpoint Integration.

embeddableConfig.title: New vs Old Records over Time

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides centralized visibility into compromised credential breaches discovered by Flashpoint.

Key metrics highlight Total Breaches, Total Records, Unique Records, and New Records. Line and area charts track Breaches over Time and New vs Old Records over Time, while a pie chart shows Breaches by Source Type and a bar chart lists Top Domains Across Breaches. A table of Largest Breaches ranks breaches by record volume.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/ti_flashpoint)**
